Class Document

java.lang.Object
be.henallux.project.model.Document
All Implemented Interfaces:
Model
public class Document extends Object implements Model
This class represents a document, which can be of various types (e.g., delivery, command, etc.). It contains certains compulsory fields like id, date of creation, document type and is checked. Regarding the optional fields, they become compulsory depending on the document type.
